message: `aria-atomic="false"` on the part sets the live region of `error` otherwise than its role does
$reason: An error part with its `alert` and `aria-atomic="false"`. Chromium 153 takes the atomicity the role implies away, where Firefox 158 gives the `alert` none to take (measured on 2026-10-27), so the engines disagree on what the role gives, and the part's region is refused anything written beside the role, as its politeness is. It costs this part nothing measured: a reader says the node that changed (Orca the inserted text unless `container-atomic` is `true`, NVDA the new text), and both engines take a node of text that is not editable as changed whole (Chromium's `ComputeHypertextRemovedAndInserted`, Firefox's `TextUpdater`), the one node here being the whole message. A part holding more nodes would be said by the one that changed. Point 7 read the part's role and politeness and what may hide it, and passed it.
